entries.title: Job 33:1
segments: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, And hearken to all my words.

entries.title: Job 33:2
segments: Behold now, I have opened my mouth; My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

entries.title: Job 33:3
segments: My words [shall utter] the uprightness of my heart; And that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.

entries.title: Job 33:4
segments: The Spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty giveth me life.

entries.title: Job 33:5
segments: If thou canst, answer thou me; Set [thy words] in order before me, stand forth.

entries.title: Job 33:6
segments: Behold, I am toward God even as thou art: I also am formed out of the clay.

entries.title: Job 33:7
segments: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.

entries.title: Job 33:8
segments: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the voice of [thy] words, [saying],

entries.title: Job 33:9
segments: I am clean, without transgression; I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me:

entries.title: Job 33:10
segments: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for his enemy:

entries.title: Job 33:11
segments: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.

entries.title: Job 33:12
segments: Behold, I will answer thee, in this thou art not just; For God is greater than man.

entries.title: Job 33:13
segments: Why dost thou strive against him, For that he giveth not account of any of his matters?

entries.title: Job 33:14
segments: For God speaketh once, Yea twice, [though man] regardeth it not.

entries.title: Job 33:15
segments: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;

entries.title: Job 33:16
segments: Then he openeth the ears of men, And sealeth their instruction,

entries.title: Job 33:17
segments: That he may withdraw man [from his] purpose, And hide pride from man;

entries.title: Job 33:18
segments: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.

entries.title: Job 33:19
segments: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And with continual strife in his bones;

entries.title: Job 33:20
segments: So that his life abhorreth bread, And his soul dainty food.

entries.title: Job 33:21
segments: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones that were not seen stick out.

entries.title: Job 33:22
segments: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, And his life to the destroyers.

entries.title: Job 33:23
segments: If there be with him an angel, An interpreter, one among a thousand, To show unto man what is right for him;

entries.title: Job 33:24
segments: Then [God] is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.

entries.title: Job 33:25
segments: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's; He returneth to the days of his youth.

entries.title: Job 33:26
segments: He prayeth unto God, and he is favorable unto him, So that he seeth his face with joy: And he restoreth unto man his righteousness.

entries.title: Job 33:27
segments: He singeth before men, and saith, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not:

entries.title: Job 33:28
segments: He hath redeemed my soul from going into the pit, And my life shall behold the light.

entries.title: Job 33:29
segments: Lo, all these things doth God work, Twice, [yea] thrice, with a man,

entries.title: Job 33:30
segments: To bring back his soul from the pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

entries.title: Job 33:31
segments: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will speak.

entries.title: Job 33:32
segments: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: Speak, for I desire to justify thee.

entries.title: Job 33:33
segments: If not, hearken thou unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.
